newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Savings Bank eyes Lithuanian market.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Savings Bank eyes Lithuanian market.

text.p: Estonian Savings Bank, the second-largest Estonian bank, said on Friday it had decided to expand into the Lithuanian market and was talking to three banks in its Baltic neighbour.
Estonian banks have been leading the expansion into neighbouring countries and two are already present in Latvia.
Savings Bank said it planned to hold further talks with Lithuania's Agrobank, Ukio Bank and Litimpeks on implementing its strategy.

Jonathan Harfield, a supervisory board member and the representative of the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) at Savings Bank said the EBRD was considering supporting Saving Bank's investment in Lithuania.
Until negotiations are completed and a deal has been signed, Savings Bank said that it will not make further comments.
Ukio Bankas is one of the top commercial banks in Lithuania while Litimpeks was allowed last year to reopen after being shut during a bank crisis in 1995.
Estonia's Hansapank already has a subsidiary in Latvia while Tallinna Pank recently bought a 20 percent stake in Latvia's Saules Bank.
